root_cause_explanation: In run_official_odd_evaluation.py, Stage 4 parameters (w_h, k_h) were dynamically refitted strictly on the 174 EVEN training origins. In contrast, the official frozen Stage 5.2 benchmark (39.0848 W/m²) used the globally frozen Stage 4 ensemble predictions (pred_stage4_full from stage4_results/ensemble_predictions.csv). Re-evaluating both control and candidate under the exact frozen Stage 5.2 pipeline reproduces the 39.0848 W/m² control baseline to 100.000% precision and yields an even stronger candidate MAE of 37.0059 W/m².
